candidates.description: This vector activates strongly for Thai script characters, sub-word tokens, and common Thai syllable components.
This feature vector activates strongly on the Thai consonant letter 'ท' and tokens containing it, including mixed-script words.
This vector activates on the Thai letter 'ส' (So Suea) appearing at the end of syllables or words, along with its associated combining vowel and tone mark diacritics.
this vector is related to the Thai consonant letter 'น' (no-nu) and character n-gram combinations containing it.
This feature vector represents common Thai syllable endings, consonant clusters, and structural prefixes found in written Thai text.
This feature vector represents sequential integer numbers.
This vector represents Thai vowel signs, diacritics, and sub-syllabic combining characters used in the Thai script.
This vector represents a collection of single Thai consonants mixed with an outlier French word.
This feature vector represents the French letter 'e' and its various accented variants (é, è, ê, ë) along with common French morphological suffixes and prefixes.
Definite and indefinite articles in various languages.
